dedupe_keys.name: lithium ion battery pack cc cv and wltp cycling tests

description: The battery-pack cycling team publishes measurements from lithium-ion pack tests with constant-current and constant-voltage charging, WLTP-style discharge and constant-discharge profiles. The current CORA Dataverse version lists many per-cycle Parquet files, including driving and capacity-check cycles, and states CC BY 4.0. Public access is free. These traces can calibrate battery ageing or dispatch constraints in storage and electric-vehicle simulations, with model-pypsa a related grid-modelling context. Coverage is the tested battery pack and laboratory cycling protocol. A caveat is that test-bench cycles do not directly represent thermal management, user charging habits or fleet diversity. Changes between dataset versions and the article's stated formats must be checked before reusing published scripts. The own repository metadata, licence and file manifest were read; no cycle files were downloaded and pack-level parameter fits were not reproduced.
